subject.title: Feature: Allow cron heartbeat interval to vary based on state conditions (deadline-aware scheduling)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public condition-evaluated scheduling contract for cron and heartbeat cadence, and what state/condition model should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix defines a new public scheduling and condition-evaluation contract with compatibility, persistence, and safety implications that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design a narrow core scheduler contract
options.body: Add one explicit condition-aware cron/heartbeat scheduling model with safe condition sources, persisted shape, doctor/migration behavior, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Split to existing narrower trackers
options.body: Keep generic conditional cadence out of scope and solve idle timeout, anti-herd phase, and retry/backoff behavior in their existing specific issues.

options.title: Expose a plugin or hook seam first
options.body: Keep core lean by adding a scheduler policy extension point only if plugins cannot currently compute or request next-run changes safely.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core scheduler contract
recommendation.body: Add one explicit condition-aware cron/heartbeat scheduling model with safe condition sources, persisted shape, doctor/migration behavior, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across cron scheduling, heartbeat docs/runtime, and prior product-review context for this surface.
